footprints.note: 114-115012.pdf (TE product specification 114-115012 Rev A, DDR4 DIMM socket solder tail), page 4, Figure 3 (recommended PCB layout, viewed from the connector side) and page 3 Figure 2 (pad = finished hole + 0.51): 288 plated holes, finished hole dia 0.66+0.08 (drawn 0.66), pad dia 0.66+0.51 = 1.17; each card side is staggered in two hole rows: 1.10 and 2.70 from the centreline (printed 1.10 and 2.70 on both sides), consecutive contacts of a side alternate between the outer and the inner row at the printed 0.85 pitch (so each hole row has pitch 1.70).
